(i) the Bochner– Martinelli type residue current and the Coleff– Herrera product associated with a tuple of weakly holomorphics functions f are well defined; (ii) these currents satisfy the transformation law; (iii) the Poincarè–Lelong formula for these currents holds; (iv) when f defines a weakly holomorphic complete intersection, the two residue currents are equivalent.
